constraints: jnp.cosh(x) is equivalent to computing jnp.cos(1j * x)
jnp.cosh(x) and jnp.cos(1j * x) return the same dtype
when x is complex, jnp.cosh(x) and jnp.cos(1j * x) return the same value

output.description: An array containing the hyperbolic cosine of each element of ``x``, promoting to inexact dtype.
